title: Auto Totem Pro
description: A lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that automatically refills your offhand with a Totem of Undying whenever it breaks, helping you stay protected during combat.
body:
# Loopix Auto Totem

A lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that automatically refills your offhand with a Totem of Undying whenever it breaks, helping you stay protected during combat.

## Supported Versions

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Minecraft 26.1.1
* Minecraft 26.1.2
* Minecraft 26.2

---

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ZeQp8HzHvik?si=NRSNbZ-BLjsjQl5Q" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

* **Instant Auto-Refill** – Automatically equips a new Totem of Undying in your offhand the moment your current totem breaks.
* **Dedicated Totem Slot** – Reserves your preferred hotbar slot (default: Slot 6) for totems and automatically restocks it from your inventory.
* **In-Game Settings (K)** – Easily configure your preferred slot, reaction delay, and refill cooldown through a simple GUI.
* **Quick Presets** – Instantly switch between **Normal (70ms)**, **Medium**, and **Ultra** delay profiles.
* **Automatic Configuration Saving** – Your settings are automatically saved to `config/autott.json`.
* **Toggle Key (V)** – Enable or disable the mod at any time with an in-game chat notification.
* **Client-Side Only** – No server-side installation is required. Works on any Fabric-compatible multiplayer server.
* **Optimized Behavior** – Uses standard Minecraft inventory interactions for smooth and reliable operation.

---

## How to Use

1. Place Totems of Undying anywhere in your inventory.
2. Keep your selected hotbar slot (default: Slot 6) available for automatic restocking.
3. When your offhand totem breaks, the mod immediately equips a replacement.
4. Press **K** to open the settings menu and customize the mod.
5. Press **V** to enable or disable Auto Totem.

---

## Requirements

* Fabric Loader **0.19.3** or newer
* Fabric API
* Minecraft **1.21.11**, **26.1.1**, **26.1.2**, or **26.2**

---

## Changelog

### v3.0.0

* Added support for Minecraft **1.21.11**, **26.1.1**, **26.1.2**, and **26.2**.
* Added an in-game settings menu (**K**).
* Added quick delay presets (**Normal, Medium, Ultra**).
* Added customizable totem slot, reaction delay, and refill cooldown.
* Added automatic configuration saving (`config/autott.json`).
* Updated for Minecraft 26.x with Mojang mappings, Java 25, and the latest Loom toolchain.

### v2.x

* Added a dedicated hotbar slot with automatic restocking.
* Added randomized delays for more natural behavior.
* Improved refill speed and overall reliability.

### v1.0.0

* Initial release.
* Automatic offhand totem refill.
* Added **V** key toggle.
